reader.requirement: At --std 85, a format 1 SEARCH WHEN condition-1 must admit every 1985 conditional expression (VI.6.3: relation including index-name relations per 6.3.1.1.3, class including ALPHABETIC-LOWER/UPPER and class-name, condition-name, switch-status, sign, negated, combined and abbreviated combined), evaluated per occurrence, while forms outside the 1985 set (XOR, <>, a bare data item) are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.SearchIndexBelowTableUnsuccessful (a general rule of the scan, not of condition-1)

reader.edition-search: the WHEN clause is the general `condition` rule bound by the one ConditionBinder.BindCondition, so the edition is consulted only through the condition-form gates of VersionConformancePass; grep Edition/Year in SearchBinder.cs
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: later editions add condition forms (XOR 2023, <> 2014, boolean and omitted-argument conditions) that 1985 refuses; the 1985 forms evaluate identically
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers relation, ALPHABETIC, condition-name, switch-status, sign NEGATIVE, negated, combined, precedence and abbreviated combined; not exercised: class-name, ALPHABETIC-LOWER/UPPER, NUMERIC, sign ZERO, arithmetic expressions with a scaled operand, index-name relations, two-level subscripts with ALL literal, reference modification, an intrinsic function (Amendment 1), and the refusal half

probes.expected: class-name 3, ALPHABETIC-UPPER 2, NOT ALPHABETIC-LOWER 2, NUMERIC 4, ZERO 4, K*2 > M+4 at 3, IX = WS-L(3) at 3, NOT < 2 AND NOT > 2 at 2, D(IX,2) = ALL "Z" at 3, refmod at 5, FUNCTION ORD at 3, none NEGATIVE -> AT END

probes.printed: error COBOL2533: an index-name or index data item is compared with an operand ... (for WHEN IX = WS-L + 1)
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.3 (Amendment 2): an index-name is compared only with an index-name, a numeric data item or a numeric literal: refused

OK  §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.3 GR2  (6.3.1.1.3 Comparisons Involving Index-Names and/or Index Data Items)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The WHEN clause reuses the one condition rule and binder, so the 1985 range is exactly what conditions admit at --std 85; every 1985 form probed evaluated correctly per occurrence and the post-1985 forms were refused. My first probe's IX = WS-L + 1 was itself illegal 1985 (index-name against an arithmetic expression) and the compiler refused it correctly.

refuter.evidence: Admitted half holds: refute-1985-159/srch-ok.cob at --std 85 (runs/srch-ok-001) printed GE 04, GE2 02, LE 03 (>=, GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO, <= on an arithmetic expression), NEQ 01 / NOTA 02 / NOTP 01 / MIX 05 (the four VI.6.3.3 expansion examples), SIGN 04, ZL-NOT 02 and ZL2 AT END (Amendment 2 zero-length group class test), GRP 03, IXN 04 -- all as the 1985 text gives. srch-bad2.cob refused NUMERIC on PIC A (COBOL6917), ALPHABETIC and class-name on numeric (COBOL6916), NUMERIC on COMP (COBOL6918), PIC 9V9 = "AB" (COBOL2532), index data item = 3 (COBOL2533); srch-bad.cob refused NOT NOT and NOT >= (COBOL0001). THE BREAK: srch-lit.cob at --std 85 compiles and runs 'WHEN 3 IS POSITIVE' and 'WHEN 1 + 1 = 2' with NO diagnostic at all (stdout A 01, B 01), also with --flag-extensions (runs/srch-lit-00x); only 'WHEN 1 = 1' draws warning COBOL3146. The 1985 text makes both non-conditional-expressions: cite.py OK §1985:VI.6.3.1.5 'Arithmetic-expression-1 must contain at least one reference to a variable'; OK §1985:VI.6.3.1.1 'The relation condition must contain at least one reference to a variable' (1+1=2 has none); SR3 leans on these: OK §1985:VI.6.22.3 SR3 'condition-1 may be any conditional expression'. Even taking non-detection as 1985 latitude, accepting them is a syntactically distinguishable extension that the warning mechanism must flag: OK §1985:I.1.5.2.5.2 'This warning mechanism is required to flag only extensions that are syntactically distinguishable' -- --flag-extensions does not. The compiler applies the 2023 reading at 1985 (2023 dropped the sign-condition sentence and relaxed the relation one to 'not a literal'; docs/conformance/3/D-RELLITERAL.md decides 1+1=2 draws nothing, reasoned from §2023 only). kb/Work search 'reference to a variable': only PB5481 (EVALUATE, landed), not this.
